label: Deluge
description: Torrents through the web UI's JSON-RPC
agentGuide: Everything is POST /json with {"method": "...", "params": [...], "id": 1}; the answer has result and error. First make sure the web UI is connected to its daemon: web.connected → if false, web.get_hosts gives [[id, host, port, user]], then web.connect [id]. Torrents: core.get_torrents_status [{}, ["name","state","progress","download_payload_rate","upload_payload_rate","eta","total_size","save_path"]] (a dict by hash). Add: core.add_torrent_magnet ["magnet:?...", {}] or core.add_torrent_url [url, {}]. Control: core.pause_torrent [[hash]], core.resume_torrent [[hash]], core.remove_torrent [hash, false] (true deletes data — ask first). Settings: core.get_config_values [["download_location","max_download_speed"]].
